## Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
install.packages("readr")
install.packages("dplyr")
library(tidyverse)  # AI-EDIT(2026-06-23): tidyverse-default — consolidated core library() calls into library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

```

## Load Data

```{r}
nhanes <- read_csv("examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
nhanes
```

## Inspect

```{r}
dim(nhanes)
names(nhanes)
glimpse(nhanes)
colSums(is.na(nhanes))
```

## Summarize

Replace this example with your own summary if you choose a different question.

```{r}
bmi_summary <- nhanes |>
  filter(!is.na(BMI), !is.na(IncomeGroup)) |>
  group_by(IncomeGroup) |>
  select(BMI, Weight, Height) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_bmi = median(BMI),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bmi_summary
```

## Function

```{r}
mean_with_n <- function(x) {
  tibble(
    n = sum(!is.na(x)),
    median = median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

mean_with_n(nhanes$BMI)
```

## Save Output

```{r}
dir.create("assignments/assignment02-r-with-ai/submission/output", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(bmi_summary, "assignments/assignment02-r-with-ai/submission/output/summary_table.csv")
```
